name: Transport, chemical tanker; residual fuel oil powered; average location mix
description: This mixing process is for the transport of 1 tonne of freight 1 kilometer via residual fuel oil powered chemical tanker. The share of transport from various origin ports to the United States is based on Vessel Entrance and Clearance data for 2023 (USACE 2023), weighted by the number of trips.
category: 48-49: Transportation and Warehousing/4831: Deep Sea, Coastal, and Great Lakes Water Transportation

processDocumentation.timeDescription: Data on origin and destination ports represents 2023.
processDocumentation.geographyDescription: This process is representative of global ocean transport.
processDocumentation.technologyDescription: The share of each trip is calculated for all vessel types, excluding container ships.
